notes: Focused public C++ TCK contract for the IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.5 p. 356 l. 293 federation-operation decision path. The current-package adapter supplies a custom Authorizer provider and protected RTI Initialization Data profile. The TCK creates a federation, requires Unauthorized from a denied Destroy Federation Execution, joins the same federation to prove it remains available, resigns, retries Destroy successfully, and disconnects. This bounded local service-behavior evidence is not full §12.5 conformance or provider interoperability evidence.
